pmdPerSite.message: If you run in Java5 or newer and have concurrent access, you should use the ConcurrentHashMap implementation
pmdPerSite.reason: A single method owns the map and captures it only for synchronous assertThrows and constructor; no concurrent access. HashMap admits the deliberate null test input.
